newsitem.title: USA: Veterinary Centers sets stock buyback.
newsitem.headline: Veterinary Centers sets stock buyback.

text.p: Veterinary Centres of America Inc on Thursday said it would buy back up to $10 million of its common stock in a programme that will end on October 31, 1997.
In a statement, Chief Executive Officer Bon Antin said the decision was based on the company's recent stock price.
Earlier, Veterinary Centres reported a third quarter net loss of $0.66 a share after charges of $0.71, versus a profit of $0.09 a share a year ago.
Several analysts cut their stock ratings on the company, and its stock was off 2 points at 8-3/8 in very heavy trading at mid-afternoon.
The shares closed at a high of 32-3/8 last April and have been on the decline ever since. They stood at 18-5/8 on Monday.
